summary: Retest of AdminOrders admin actions after main agent fixed the pre-existing double-/api bugs (changeStatus, resendEmail, createCourtesy). Executed a full end-to-end UI flow against production URL as admin: created a COURTESY order via 'Gerar cortesia', verified it appears in the list, opened its detail modal, changed status via order-status-select (toast 'Status atualizado'), clicked 'Reenviar e-mail' (toast with credencial count), then deleted the order via the modal 'Excluir pedido' button (toast 'Pedido excluído · 1 credencial(is) removida(s)') and confirmed it disappears from the filtered list. All 4 flows PASS 7/7 assertions. Delete regression also confirmed (modal delete testid=order-delete).

design_issues.screen: AdminOrders — courtesy dialog & order detail dialog
issues: Console warning: shadcn DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby`. Cosmetic accessibility warning, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 handlers in AdminOrders.jsx now use paths without leading /api — consistent with axios baseURL. Verified in code (lines 62, 71, 87, 100).
Minor a11y warning on DialogContent (missing aria-describedby) shows in console for both the courtesy dialog and the order detail dialog. Not user-facing.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 courtesy order (TEST_courtesy_*) and deleted it in the same run. Net orders count unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminOrders.jsx is now fully green: change status, resend email, manual courtesy, and delete (row + modal) all working end-to-end. Only remaining polish is the a11y warning on shadcn DialogContent (add DialogDescription / aria-describedby).
rca of the issue: Previously all 4 mutating axios calls in AdminOrders.jsx had a duplicated /api prefix (baseURL already includes /api → resulted in /api/api/... 404). Main agent removed the leading /api from changeStatus (PUT /admin/orders-actions/{id}/status), resendEmail (POST /admin/orders-actions/{id}/resend-email), createCourtesy (POST /admin/orders-actions/manual-courtesy). Delete was already fixed in iteration 3. This retest confirms all 4 endpoints are reachable and produce the expected UI toasts.
